spec.hypothesis: SDGD v2 with confidence-gated merge + min_batch_size=8 addresses merge amplification, achieving F1 > 0.445 (single_pass baseline) on Few-NERD
spec.design: 4 modes: sdgd_zero (confidence merge), single_pass, random_batch, per_type. min_batch_size=8 reduces 8→4 batches. Confidence threshold=-1.0 (keep all, rank by confidence for conflict resolution)

metrics.per_type: killed before completion (3/4 modes done, Director approved kill)
metrics.vs_v1: confidence-gated merge did not improve over union merge. sdgd_zero 0.241 vs v1 0.251, random_batch 0.301 vs v1 0.320
metrics.key_finding: SDGD v2 confidence-gated merge + min_batch_size=8 failed to beat single_pass baseline (F1=0.445). Both v1 and v2 confirm decomposition hurts precision more than it helps recall. Claim 3 (SDGD framework) needs fundamental rethink.

experiment_data.notes: SDGD v2 killed by Director after 3/4 modes completed (per_type still running). Trend clear: all decomposition modes F1 < baseline. Confidence-gated merge did not fix merge amplification. v1 and v2 both negative → Claim 3 needs fundamental rethink.
